text: Figure 3.26: Parameter description [ecuc_sws_3007] All inheriting metamodel classes representing an ECU Conﬁguration Value specify an attribute value that stores the conﬁguration value in XML-based description. [ecuc_sws_3038] The reference definition assigns the EcucParameterValue23 to the according EcucParameterDef it is providing the value for. [ecuc_sws_3009] If a defaultValue is speciﬁed in the ECU Conﬁguration Parameter Deﬁnition that given value can be used as the initialvalue of the according EcucParameterValue for the ECU Conﬁguration Value description as explained in section 5.2. [ecuc_sws_3034] In a well-formed and completed ECU Conﬁguration Value description each provided parameter needs to have a value speciﬁed even if it is just copied from the defaultValue of the ECU Conﬁguration Deﬁnition. 23and all its sub-classes 122 of 205 — AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL — Document ID 087: AUTOSAR_TPS_ECUConﬁguration.pdf
